feature_definitions.distance_to_origin_50m: Minimum Haversine distance (metres) to 50% contour centroid
feature_definitions.distance_to_origin_90m: Minimum Haversine distance (metres) to 90% contour centroid
feature_definitions.min_distance_to_origin: Minimum of the two contour distances
feature_definitions.mean_distance_to_origin: Mean distance to 50% centroid across all candidate observations
feature_definitions.track_duration_seconds: Elapsed seconds from first to last candidate observation
feature_definitions.dwell_duration_seconds: Sum of observation time-deltas within origin region (seconds)
feature_definitions.stationary_fraction: Fraction of observations where SOG < stationary_speed_threshold
feature_definitions.heading_change_count: Count of consecutive COG changes >= heading_change_threshold
feature_definitions.displacement_difference_m: Observed minus expected displacement (metres); sign and magnitude only — not an anomaly score
